functional.description: The solution uses the Plane API endpoint 'http://localhost:8091' (or 'http://plane-api:8000')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Plane instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates with Plane using the required credentials or API token
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access

functional.description: The solution uses the LocalStack S3 endpoint 'http://localhost:4566' (or 'http://localstack:4566') to upload the report
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution uploads the report to LocalStack S3

robustness.description: The script extracts issue metadata (identifier, title, created_at, closed_at) by trying multiple field name variations for each piece of data.
robustness.rationale: Increases resilience to API schema variations, ensuring the script can extract necessary information even when field names differ from expected values.

robustness.description: The script normalizes the Plane base URL to ensure it ends with '/api/v1' regardless of the input format.
robustness.rationale: Prevents API request failures due to incorrect URL formatting, ensuring consistent endpoint construction regardless of how the base URL is configured.

robustness.description: The script handles negative duration values by using max(duration, 0.0) when calculating resolution hours.
robustness.rationale: Prevents invalid negative resolution times that could occur due to data inconsistencies or clock skew, ensuring all reported durations are logically valid.

robustness.description: The script handles missing or invalid timestamps (created_at or closed_at) by skipping those issues rather than failing completely.
robustness.rationale: Prevents the entire report generation from failing due to missing timestamp data in individual issues, ensuring the script produces results even with incomplete data.

robustness.description: The script parses ISO 8601 timestamp strings from the Plane API correctly correctly.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the script can parse ISO 8601 timestamp strings from the Plane API correctly.
